events.title: Alert staff of
events.description: Moves into a status alert the staff when that status's Staff alert is on (Order statuses and moves).

recipients.title: Alert recipients
recipients.description: Email addresses and international phone numbers (+ or 00 first; phones get the channel below). Name a channel first to choose it for one person: sms:+15550100, whatsapp:+15550100, email:ops@example.com, or push:<Accounts user id> for staff push.

staffPermission.title: Also alert Accounts staff who can
staffPermission.description: Every unblocked Accounts user whose role has this Ecommerce permission; all_staff: every one who works with the alert's subject (orders.read for orders, returns.manage for claims). Both need the Accounts token. Empty = only the list above.

phoneChannel.title: Phones get
phoneChannel.description: SMS goes out with Ecommerce's default words; WhatsApp needs your own approved templates in Notifications.

staffPush.title: Staff push too
staffPush.description: Accounts staff also get a push in their browser (Notifications: Staff push, with your push keys).

maxRecipients.title: People per alert
maxRecipients.description: At most this many people get one alert (the list first, then the Accounts staff).

adminUrl.title: Order page in your admin
adminUrl.description: With {number} and {id}, for example https://admin.example.com/orders/{id}. Alerts link to it.

includePhone.title: Alerts carry the shopper's phone
includePhone.description: Adds the value {phone} (the phone on the order) to every staff alert.
